blockingIssues.description: Backend Python scripts under `part64/scripts/` still contain stale daimoi imports and payload keys, including `code.world_web.daimoi_probabilistic` in `bench_cdb_vs_python.py` and multiple `daimoi_*` fields in `ensure_npu_embeddings.py` / `eval_sim_learning_suite.py`, so VAL-BR-002 is not fully satisfied.

`part64/code/world_life.py` still emits narrative actor ids (`scribe_aya`, `cantor_ren`, `keeper_mio`, `witness_kai`, `weaver_noa`) and still accepts the `pray` action, so the world-life payload remains partially narrative.
`part64/code/world_web/constants.py` still ships the narrative projection id `nexus.ui.inspiration_atlas`, leaving PROJECTION_ELEMENTS only partially renamed.

The backend removed `/api/muse/*` and `/api/witness*` without updating checked-in frontend callers (`App.tsx`, `useChatCommandHandlers.ts`, `Chat.tsx`, `ThreatRadarPanel.tsx`, `Canvas.tsx`), so the repository no longer has a working frontend/backend contract for these flows.
The backend now emits `agent_events`, but `part64/frontend/src/hooks/useWorldState.ts` still only handles `muse_events`, so live runtime updates regress across the checked-in stack.

`part64/code/tests/test_agent_runtime.py` was renamed but still asserts the removed muse-era API (`muse_id`, `list_muses`, `muse.*`, `presence_type == "muse"`) instead of the current agent runtime surface.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: When backend API or event contracts change, require verification of checked-in client consumers or temporary compatibility aliases before declaring the milestone working.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: `update-api-and-records` renamed server routes and WebSocket event types, but the checked-in frontend still calls `/api/muse/*`, `/api/witness*`, and listens for `muse_events`, creating a cross-surface regression not caught by the worker's recorded verification.
